import notes from './notes.txt?raw';

export const sources = [
  { name: 'notes.txt', code: notes, language: 'plaintext', edit: false, default: true },
  { name: 'hidden.txt', code: 'Editable source outside the preview list.', language: 'plaintext', edit: true },
];

export const viewports = [
  { id: "wide", label: "Wide", width: 900, icon: "desktop" },
  { id: "small", label: "Small", width: 420, icon: "phone" },
];

<StudioShell>
<StudioHeader title="Authored workspace" breadcrumbs={["Custom section", "Authored navigation"]} homeTab="examples" onNavigate={props.studio.setTab} actions={<StudioActions sources={sources.filter(file => file.name === "hidden.txt")} copy={false} />} />
<StudioBody>
<LayoutLibrary groups={props.studio.groups.filter(group => group.label === "Test")} selectedId={props.studio.presetId} onSelect={props.studio.loadPreset} open={props.studio.libraryOpen} />
<Workspace>
<PageHeading>

# Authored MDX heading

This page has its own panels and deliberately omits the inspector.

</PageHeading>

<WorkspaceTabs defaultValue="examples" value={props.studio.tab} onValueChange={props.studio.setTab} suffix={frontmatter.label}>

<WorkspacePanel id="examples" label="Examples">

<SourceEditor sources={sources.filter(file => file.name === "notes.txt")} mode="preview" targetTab="explore" />

[Ordinary notes link](./notes.txt)

<SourceFiles title="Files from this page" sources={sources} onOpen={name => props.studio.showSource(name, "explore")}>

- [**Read my notes**](./notes.txt "Notes source")
- [Unknown file](./missing.txt)

</SourceFiles>

- [Custom reference](https://example.com)

</WorkspacePanel>
<WorkspacePanel id="explore" label="Edit files">

<SourceEditor sources={sources.filter(file => file.name === "notes.txt")} />

<SourceEditor sources={sources.filter(file => file.name === "hidden.txt")} />

<InTheWild title="Frontmatter examples" examples={frontmatter.inTheWild} />


<StudioLivePreview sources={sources} controls={<PreviewVariantControls options={props.studio.activeLayout.variants.map(variant => ({ id: variant.id, label: variant.label ?? variant.name }))} value={props.studio.presetId} onValueChange={props.studio.loadPreset} />} viewports={viewports} />

</WorkspacePanel>
</WorkspaceTabs>
</Workspace>
</StudioBody>
</StudioShell>
